# Welcome!

This portal automatically ingests, processes, and displays environemntal monitoring data of the following lakes:

- [Bolmen](/pages/bol/bol-main.qmd) 
- [Vombsjön](/pages/vom/vom-main.qmd)
- [Ringsjön](/pages/rin/rin-main.qmd)

and from [Testbed Plönninge](/pages/plo/plo-main.qmd)

## Data Resources

The following data is used on this portal: 

| Type of Data | Datasource | Reference |
| ------------ | ---------- | --------- |
| Meteorological data | SMHI Open Data | [@SMHI_OpenData] |
| Water Quality data | SITES, Sydvatten | [@SITTES_Dataportal, @BOL] |
| Hydrological data | Sydvatten | [@BOL] |

For the visualization of color the scientific color maps of @Crameri_2023 have been used.
